title: Unit 20 Consolidation: Industrialization
goal: Review the unit on industrialization: import substitution, new industries, migration, new urban societies and the balance of results and limits.

items: I can sum up the causes and results of import substitution.
I can say how governments and state companies built new industries.
I can say what people stopped doing and what they kept doing in the migration to the cities.
I can say how cities, neighbourhoods and classes changed.
I can weigh results and limits of industrialization with a pesar de.
